description:
The brand's rules for whoever writes, Sightkick or you (Settings → Writing, Images). voice, key_facts and rules replace the whole text: read get_settings writing first.
action:
- author(name, credentials?, sameAs?): The byline: name, credentials, up to 6 https profiles (sameAs).
- remove_author: Pages fall back to the brand's byline.
- voice(text): How every page sounds, in a few sentences.
- key_facts(keyFacts): The facts every page may state: prices, features, who it's for.
- rules(add?, replace?): The do's and don'ts: add one line, or replace them all.
- images(screenshots?, brandColor?, cardBackground?, font?): The title card's background, highlight colour and font, and screenshots on Sightkick's own pages: fields left out stay.
name: update_writing
title: Change the writing rules
